blind_banks: not used, generated or consulted; none exist
cell: family x mining seed x validation seed; gate = precision >= 0.9, terminal recall >= 0.8, exact path recall >= 0.75; abstention and zero detections fail; ineligible families reported, never dropped

J.status: known; source of the K hypotheses

KDEV.status: new, written by C knowing the hypotheses; favours K by construction

lock_recommendation.L1: no regression: every cell J passes on I, H, J and KDEV sources is also passed
lock_recommendation.L2: all cells pass on the J pre-match families and on all four KDEV families
lock_recommendation.L3: J live families keep all 12 cells
lock_recommendation.L4: L1-L3 also hold at at least one grid point adjacent to the default (4/5, 3/4)
lock_recommendation.L5: no family, mechanism or scenario name in experimental_k (AST/text check); H, I and J code hashes unchanged
lock_recommendation.candidate: among variants with no regression (L1), the one with most passing cells; ties go to fewer components (parsimony)
lock_recommendation.result: GO for the definitive K lock only if L1-L5 hold; otherwise NO-GO and the negative results are published. The final decision is human.

negatives: every variant, source, cell and abstention is published, including variants that regress
sensitivity: every variant on the 3 x 3 grid consensus {3/4, 4/5, 5/6} x regular {2/3, 3/4, 4/5} for the J and KDEV sources
shared_parameters: every variant keeps all J constants (consensus 4/5, regular 3/4, min fixtures 5, min days 2, terminals 11/10, half share 1/4, ambiguity 1/2, 2 rounds, mining work 1 800 000, matcher 300 000); K2 adds min_known = 1/2 of the fired fixtures; K1 adds max_enumerated_shapes = 48 per phase, ordered by sampled fixture support

variants.J_K1: J + shapes enumerated from the sampled trajectories, in addition to the generator shortlist
variants.J_K2: J + consensus measured only over fixtures where the predicate value is observable; unknown values stay indeterminate in matching
variants.J_K3: J + replication re-selects each calendar half without the nested half-stability check, requiring the same shape
